claim_boundary: Generic synthetic single-node capability evidence only; not user workload compatibility, distributed behavior, high availability, or production certification.
failure: ExceptionGroup: unhandled errors in a TaskGroup (2 sub-exceptions) | RuntimeError: Varve HTTP 400: derived resident/working byte budget exceeded | RuntimeError: Varve HTTP 400: derived resident/working byte budget exceeded

infrastructure_assumptions.ownership: infrastructure, secrets, CPU/RSS/disk metrics, and cleanup are external
infrastructure_assumptions.region: Singapore; supplied by infrastructure owner, not independently detected

timescale.freshness_timing_scope: elapsed ingestion plus immediate maintenance barrier; includes ANALYZE for Timescale

matched_durability.scope: single-node local durable acknowledgement; no replicated durability claim

timescale_setup_commands: CREATE INDEX measurements_tenant_series_ts_idx ON measurements (tenant, series, ts DESC) INCLUDE (value)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW minute_rollup WITH (timescaledb.continuous) ... WITH NO DATA
explicit refresh_continuous_aggregate barriers; no background refresh policy
